## findings

1. **SOURCE-POLICY RED — E2's declared sentence does not single out its resolving write; the rule carries a second, broader wording that does.** Symptom: "…fixed only after the claim's highest-numbered posting denied for the same reason stands in a Claim Factual Reconsideration that is filed or under review" is satisfied by P1 opened on line 5 as well as by P2 joining line 5; the rule also says "The next level hears a claim only once every posting of it denied for the same reason is under review at some level…". Root cause: `_difficulty.md` G-1, G-5. Evidence: P3 rule (extended.yaml lines 1300–1306); P1 rule line 886; seed lines 4 `e19db50e` and 5 `131054d7`. Demonstrated consequence on this world: with only line 5 placed in a CFR the declared sentence is met and the second wording is not (§ policy_self_consistency); the gold route is reachable only through the second wording, and the proof's "exactly one write" assertion is false against the declared sentence. Affected: `appeal.extended.yaml` P3 `rule` and `prerequisite[0]`; `0.json` design_rationale problem-tree card (a). Relation to previous revisions: first audit.
2. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED — payment-method ladders conditioned on a fact true of every Select tier.** Symptom: tier 2 of `first_line_payment_method`, `joining_line_payment_method`, `review_line_payment_method` requires "the tier the line was billed under makes TRICARE pay second to other health insurance"; `select.yaml` sets `tricare_secondary_to_ohi: true` in all six variants. Root cause: `_difficulty.md` G-7. Demonstrated consequence: on this world the tier is decided by the counted OHI (96.30 / 104.75 / 52.80) alone; with the factor struck, P1 and P2 each have 3 surviving factors (2 parameter, 1 method), below the floor of 4. Affected: P1, P2, P3 `factors[payment_method]` and the matching rule sentences; `0.json` computations[0..1] factor counts. First audit.
3. Observation — the OHI tier of P3 rests on the document `7bdc9caf` of kind `explanation_of_benefits`, which is also the kind of TRICARE explanation of benefits a Claim Factual Reconsideration requires (`required_documents: [explanation_of_benefits]`); the record does not say whose EOB it is. The persona settles it only when asked about other insurance ("you sent its explanation of benefits in with your reconsideration"). If the agent took it for the TRICARE EOB it would get 92.84 instead of 50.60. Reachable, so not a red light.
4. Observation — charter-global items that do not bite on this world: G-6 (provider participating), G-9 (non-network line), O-1/O-2 (one filed record; the gold's customer-id `target_holding_id` makes P2's compute patient-wide), O-3, O-5 (E2 `gate` is a column), O-6.
5. Observation — the persona's simulator instructions name the three forms ("opening a reconsideration, adding a visit to it, or asking for the formal review") and the re-billing; all are inside passive branches and are never volunteered. Not a red light.
